rubric.role_summary: Partner marketing manager in growth marketing, owning joint go-to-market plans, co-marketing campaigns, partner enablement, and performance measurement with strategic technology and financial-services partners.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Partner marketing manager in growth marketing, owning joint go-to-market plans, co-marketing campaigns, partner enablement, and performance measurement with strategic technology and financial-services partners.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 6+ years of relevant B2B marketing experience, including partner- or channel-marketing roles.
- Experience working closely with technology OR consulting partners to build joint marketing plans that drive customer acquisition and pipeline generation; AI-specific partner experience is not a separate mandatory condition.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience at a high-growth technology company.
- Experience in payments, financial technology, Credit, Lending, or Banking.
- Background in partner enablement, revenue enablement, or sales enablement.
- Experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo or HubSpot, or CRM such as Salesforce.
- Experience with learning management systems and employee enablement intranet platforms.
- Ability to use AI tools and technologies to improve efficiency, automate workflows, and scale impact.
- Ability to influence partner marketing leadership teams and align on joint objectives and priorities.
- Experience shaping joint messaging with partners and translating product positioning into partner-ready content.
- Demonstrated ability to measure and improve marketing-investment ROI through an indirect or partner business model.
- Deep understanding of the partner channel funnel, sales cycle, and product lifecycle.
- Cross-functional experience aligning stakeholders across partnerships, product marketing, product, and communications.
- Experience engaging enterprise-level stakeholders and presenting to senior audiences.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California; New York metropolitan area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
